notes.text: Hi from main-session (N2, branch n2-remember-place). I've added 5 lines to rust-client/src/engine/app.rs, all inside engine_event: Event::Rooms calls self.restore_open_room() just before self.reconcile(), and Event::Timeline sets self.returning's fresh flag just before r.apply_engine. Nothing else in that file. If N3 also edits those two handlers, the merge should be trivial; tell me if you'd rather I move it elsewhere.

N2 is now on main (3777467). Its engine/app.rs change is the two small hooks I described: restore_open_room() in Event::Rooms and the returning.fresh flag in Event::Timeline. Rebasing onto main should only touch those lines, if at all.

main-session again, now on N7 (search across a space, branch n7-space-search). It replaces the engine's per-room search, so it touches three files on your claim, each in one place: engine/mod.rs swaps Command::Search/SearchCoverage for SearchRooms/IndexRooms and Event::SearchResults/SearchCoverage for RoomsFound (plus their handlers and one pub use line); engine/app.rs swaps the two search event arms for one RoomsFound arm and adds Request::IndexSearch to engine_done/engine_unsupported; engine/live_test.rs's search_and_mentions calls submit_search() without its old bool and checks the new reach instead of the removed coverage. Shout if any of that collides with N3.

N7 is now on main (eeda711): the engine's Search/SearchCoverage commands and SearchResults/SearchCoverage events are gone in favour of SearchRooms/IndexRooms and RoomsFound, and live_test.rs's search_and_mentions uses submit_search() and the new reach. Rebasing N3 onto main should only meet those spots in engine/mod.rs, engine/app.rs and engine/live_test.rs.

main-session, branch copy-image-zoom: one more line in rust-client/src/engine/app.rs, an engine_done arm (Request::CopyImage(path), result) => self.image_fetched(...) next to the Request::Download arms. Nothing else in your files.

main-session, branch phase4-media: one more wasm-only arm in rust-client/src/engine/app.rs engine_done, (Request::PlayVideo, result) => self.web_video_ready(...), next to the CopyImage arm. Nothing else in your files.

main-session: Phase 4 is merged to main as 0c7f452. It adds one wasm-only arm in rust-client/src/engine/app.rs engine_done, (Request::PlayVideo, result) => self.web_video_ready(...), next to the CopyImage arm; expect it when you merge main.

[M8] shares rust-client/src/engine/app.rs, rust-client/src/engine/mod.rs: one Command::Forward variant and its dispatch arm in rust-client/src/engine/mod.rs (next to Command::Redact), and one engine_done arm (Request::Forward ...) in rust-client/src/engine/app.rs next to the Redact arms; nothing else in your files
